en.s: The siege of Syracuse from 877 to 878 led to the fall of the city of Syracuse, the Byzantine capital of Sicily, to the Aghlabids. The siege lasted from August 877 to 21 May 878 when the city, effectively left without assistance by the central Byzantine government, was taken by the Aghlabid forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 877年至878年的锡拉库萨围城战导致阿格拉布王朝攻陷锡拉库萨。这座城市曾是拜占庭帝国在西西里的首府。围城从877年8月持续至878年5月21日；拜占庭中央政府实际上没有提供援助，阿格拉布军队最终攻占该城。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的围城结束日期。

en.t: Sixteen-year-old Otto III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: The Holy Roman Emperor, originally and officially the Emperor of the Romans (Latin: Imperator Romanorum; German: Kaiser der Römer) during the Middle Ages, and also known as the Roman-German Emperor since the early modern period (Latin: Imperator Germanorum; German: Römisch-deutscher Kaiser), was the ruler and head of state of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.t: 16岁的奥托三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝
zh.s: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝在中世纪原称“罗马人的皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Romanorum；德语：Kaiser der Römer），近代早期起也称“罗马—德意志皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Germanorum；德语：Römisch-deutscher Kaiser），是神圣罗马帝国的统治者和国家元首。

en.t: Coronation of Michael IX Palaiologos as Byzantine Emperor
en.s: Michael IX Palaiologos or Palaeologus (Byzantine Greek: Μιχαὴλ Δούκας Ἄγγελος Κομνηνὸς Παλαιολόγος, romanized: Mikhaḗl Doúkās Ángelos Komnēnós Palaiológos; 17 April 1277 – 12 October 1320) was Byzantine emperor together with his father, Andronikos II Palaiologos, from 1294 until his death. Andronikos II and Michael IX ruled as equal co-rulers, both using the title autokrator.

zh.t: 米海尔九世加冕为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 米海尔九世·帕莱奥列格（拜占庭希腊语：Μιχαὴλ Δούκας Ἄγγελος Κομνηνὸς Παλαιολόγος，转写为Mikhaḗl Doúkās Ángelos Komnēnós Palaiológos；1277年4月17日—1320年10月12日）自1294年起与其父安德洛尼卡二世·帕莱奥列格共同担任拜占庭皇帝，直至去世。安德洛尼卡二世和米海尔九世以平等共治者身份统治，均使用“独裁者”（autokrator）这一称号。

en.t: Coronation of John VI Kantakouzenos as Byzantine Emperor by patriarch Isidore I of Constantinople at the Church of St. Mary of Blachernae
en.s: John VI Kantakouzenos or Cantacuzene (Greek: Ἰωάννης Ἄγγελος [Κομνηνός] Παλαιολόγος Καντακουζηνός, romanized: Iōánnēs Ángelos [Komnēnós] Palaiológos Kantakouzēnós; Latin: Iohannes Cantacuzenus; 6 May 1292– 15 June 1383) was a Byzantine emperor and nobleman, statesman, and general. He served as grand domestic under Andronikos III Palaiologos and regent for John V Palaiologos before reigning as Byzantine emperor in his own right from 1347 to 1354.

zh.t: 约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯在布拉赫奈圣母教堂加冕为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯（希腊语：Ἰωάννης Ἄγγελος [Κομνηνός] Παλαιολόγος Καντακουζηνός，转写：Iōánnēs Ángelos [Komnēnós] Palaiológos Kantakouzēnós；拉丁语：Iohannes Cantacuzenus；1292年5月6日—1383年6月15日）是拜占庭皇帝、贵族、政治家和将领。他曾在安德洛尼卡三世·巴列奥略统治期间担任大宫廷总管，并在约翰五世·巴列奥略年幼时担任摄政，之后于1347年至1354年以皇帝身份亲自统治。

en.t: Dušan's Code, the constitution of the Serbian Empire, is enacted by Dušan the Mighty
en.s: The Serbian Empire (Serbian: Српско царство / Srpsko carstvo, pronounced [sr̩̂pskoː tsâːrstʋo]) was a medieval Serbian state that emerged from the Kingdom of Serbia. It was established in 1346 by Dušan the Mighty, who significantly expanded the state. During Dušan's rule, Serbia was one of the most powerful European states and the most powerful in Southeast Europe.

zh.t: 塞尔维亚帝国宪法《杜尚法典》颁布
zh.s: 塞尔维亚帝国（塞尔维亚语：Српско царство / Srpsko carstvo）是由塞尔维亚王国发展而来的中世纪国家，由杜尚大帝于1346年建立并大幅扩张。在杜尚统治时期，塞尔维亚是欧洲最强大的国家之一，也是东南欧最强大的国家。

en.t: Coronation of James I of Scotland at Scone
en.s: James I (late July 1394 – 21 February 1437) was King of Scots from 1406 to 1437. The youngest of three sons, he was born in Dunfermline Abbey to King Robert III and his wife Annabella Drummond. His older brother David, Duke of Rothesay died under suspicious circumstances while being detained by their uncle, Robert, Duke of Albany. His other brother, Robert, died young.

zh.t: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯一世在斯昆加冕
zh.s: 詹姆斯一世（1394年7月下旬—1437年2月21日）于1406年至1437年担任苏格兰国王。他是三兄弟中最年幼的一位，出生于邓弗姆林修道院，父亲为罗伯特三世国王，母亲为安娜贝拉·德拉蒙德。他的哥哥罗斯赛公爵大卫被叔父奥尔巴尼公爵罗伯特拘禁期间，在可疑情况下去世；另一位哥哥罗伯特则早逝。

en.s: The Battle of Rügen was a naval battle near the island of Rügen (in modern Germany), that took place on 21 May 1565 between an allied fleet of 6 Danish and 3 Lübeck ships, and a Swedish fleet of 48 ships with a total of 1,638 guns and 8,000 men under Klas Horn. The Swedish fleet was victorious, and 4 of the allied ships were burned, while the remaining 5 were captured.

zh.s: 吕根岛海战于1565年5月21日在今德国吕根岛附近爆发。交战双方是一支由6艘丹麦船和3艘吕贝克船组成的联合舰队，以及克拉斯·霍恩率领的瑞典舰队；瑞典舰队有48艘船、1,638门火炮和8,000名士兵。瑞典获胜，联军有4艘船被焚毁，其余5艘被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Mimaomote (三間表の戦い, Mimaomote no tatakai) was a battle during the Azuchi–Momoyama period (16th century) of Japan. The Battle of Mimaomote was initiated by Chōsokabe commander Kumu Yorinobu with 7,000 men as he advanced into Iyo Province on Shikoku Island. There Kumu Yorinobu attacked Kōno forces under Doi Kiyonaga, who had crossed the Mimaomote River to engage him. Yorinobu was defeated and killed.

zh.s: 三间表战役（日语：三間表の戦い，Mimaomote no tatakai）是日本安土桃山时代的一场战斗。长宗我部氏将领久武赖信率7000人进攻四国伊予国，河野氏军队在土居清良率领下渡过三间表川迎战。久武赖信战败身亡。

en.s: The capture of Wakefield occurred during the First English Civil War when a Parliamentarian force attacked the Royalist garrison of Wakefield, Yorkshire. The Parliamentarians were outnumbered, having around 1,500 men under the command of Sir Thomas Fairfax, compared to the 3,000 led by George Goring in Wakefield. Despite being outnumbered, Parliamentarians successfully stormed the town, taking roughly 1,400 prisoners.

zh.s: 英国内战第一次战争期间，议会军进攻约克郡韦克菲尔德的保王党驻军。议会军人数较少，托马斯·费尔法克斯爵士率领约1,500人，而乔治·戈林在韦克菲尔德率领3,000人。尽管处于劣势，议会军仍成功攻入城镇，俘虏约1,400人。

en.s: The second and longest siege of Worcester (21 May – 23 July 1646) took place towards the end of the First English Civil War, when Parliamentary forces under the command of Thomas Rainsborough besieged the city of Worcester, accepting the capitulation of the Royalist defenders on 22 July. The next day the Royalists formally surrendered possession of the city, and the Parliamentarians entered Worcester 63 days after the siege began.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伍斯特第二次、也是历时最长的围城战于1646年5月21日至7月23日进行，发生在第一次英国内战末期。托马斯·雷恩斯伯勒率领议会军围困伍斯特，城内保王党守军于7月22日接受投降。次日，保王党正式交出城市，议会军在围城开始63天后进入伍斯特。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的围城开始日期。

en.s: The Concert of The Hague, signed on 21 May 1659, was an outline of the common stance of England, France and the Dutch Republic regarding the Second Northern War. The powers agreed that the Swedish Empire and Denmark–Norway should settle for a peace treaty based on the Treaty of Roskilde, including free navigation through The Sound and the Baltic Sea based on the Treaty of Elbing.

zh.s: 《海牙协定》于1659年5月21日签署，概述了英格兰、法国和荷兰共和国对第二次北方战争的共同立场。三国同意瑞典帝国与丹麦—挪威以《罗斯基勒条约》为基础缔结和平条约，其中包括依据《埃尔布林条约》，确保船只可自由通行厄勒海峡和波罗的海。

en.s: The Battle of Long Sault occurred over a five-day period in early May 1660 during the Beaver Wars. It was fought between French colonial militia, with their Wendat (Huron) and Algonquin allies, against the Haudenosaunee Confederacy (Iroquois). Some historians theorize that the Haudenosaunee called off an intended attack on French settlements because one of their chiefs was killed in this battle, while others claim that the battle provided enough trophies to temper Haudenosaunee aims.
en.n: The Battle of Long Sault concludes after five days in which French colonial militia, with their Huron and Algonquin allies, are defeated by the Haudenosaunee Confederacy.

zh.s: 长索尔战役发生在海狸战争期间，持续了1660年5月上旬的五天。参战双方是法国殖民民兵及其休伦（温达特）和阿尔冈昆盟友，对抗易洛魁联盟（豪德诺索尼）。一些历史学家认为，豪德诺索尼取消了原计划中的法国殖民地袭击，原因是其一名酋长在此战中阵亡；另一些人则认为，此战获得了足够多的战利品，足以减弱豪德诺索尼的进攻意愿。
zh.n: 长索尔战役在持续五天后结束；法国殖民民兵及其休伦和阿尔冈昆盟友战败。

en.t: Henry Morgan's raid on Lake Maracaibo
en.s: Henry Morgan's raid on Lake Maracaibo, also known as the Sack of Maracaibo and the Battle of Lake Maracaibo, was a military event that took place between 16 March and 21 May 1669 during the latter stage of the Anglo-Spanish War. English privateers commanded by notable Buccaneer Henry Morgan launched an attack with the purpose of raiding Spanish towns along the coastline inside of Lake Maracaibo in the Spanish Province of Venezuela.

zh.t: 亨利·摩根袭击马拉开波湖
zh.s: 亨利·摩根袭击马拉开波湖又称马拉开波劫掠或马拉开波湖之战，是英西战争后期的一场军事行动，于1669年3月16日至5月21日进行。英国私掠船队由著名海盗亨利·摩根指挥，袭击西班牙委内瑞拉省马拉开波湖沿岸的城镇。

en.s: The Battle of Blomidon took place on 21 May 1781 during the American Revolutionary War. The naval battle involved three armed U.S. privateer vessels against three Nova Scotian vessels off Cape Split, Nova Scotia. American Privateers caught two Nova Scotia Vessels. The first Nova Scotia vessel was re-captured by Lieut Benjamin Belcher. The second Nova Scotia vessel was overtaken by the captured crew under the command of Captain Bishop.

zh.s: 布洛明登之战于1781年5月21日爆发，是美国独立战争期间的一场海战。美国3艘武装私掠船在新斯科舍省斯普利特角外海与3艘新斯科舍船只交战。美国私掠船俘获了两艘新斯科舍船只，第一艘后来被本杰明·贝尔彻中尉夺回；第二艘则被已被俘船只上的船员夺回，带队者是毕晓普船长。

en.s: The 1792 Unzen landslide and tsunami was a volcanic megadisaster, occurring on 21 May 1792, during the Edo period. Triggered by the volcanic activity of Mount Unzen (on the Shimabara Peninsula, Nagasaki Prefecture, Kyushu, Japan), it caused a massive collapse of the Mayuyama lava dome and a subsequent tsunami. Approximately 15,000 people lost their lives, making it the largest scale volcanic disaster in Japanese history.

zh.s: 1792年5月21日，日本江户时代发生云仙山崩塌与海啸这场火山巨灾。长崎县岛原半岛的云仙山火山活动引发眉山熔岩穹丘大规模崩塌，随后发生海啸。约1.5万人遇难，是日本历史上规模最大的火山灾害。

en.s: The siege of Derbent (or the storming of Derbent; Russian: Штурм Дербента) took place on 21 May [O.S. 10 May] 1796 during the Persian Expedition of 1796. Derbent, an ancient city with thick walls has a favorable geopolitical position, which locks the coastal passage between the Caucasus Mountains and the Caspian Sea.

zh.s: 杰尔宾特围城战又称杰尔宾特风暴战（俄语：Штурм Дербента），发生于1796年5月21日（俄历5月10日），是1796年波斯远征期间的一场战斗。古城杰尔宾特城墙厚实，地缘位置重要，扼守高加索山脉和里海之间的沿海通道。

en.s: The siege of Acre of 1799 was an unsuccessful French siege of the Ottoman city of Acre and was the turning point of Napoleon's invasion of Egypt and Syria, along with the Battle of the Nile. It was Napoleon's third tactical defeat in his career, being defeated at the Second Battle of Bassano and the Battle of Caldiero three years previously during the Italian campaign, and his first major strategic defeat, along with the last time he was defeated in battle for 10 years.
en.n: The end of the Siege of Acre (1799): Napoleon Bonaparte abandons his siege of the Ottoman city of Acre after two months. This was the turning point of Bonaparte's Egyptian campaign and one of the first major defeats he suffered in his military career.

zh.s: 1799年阿卡围城战是法国军队未能攻下奥斯曼城市阿卡的一次围城，也是拿破仑入侵埃及和叙利亚的转折点，与尼罗河战役同样重要。这是拿破仑军事生涯中的第三次战术性失败；此前三年前的意大利战役中，他在第二次巴萨诺战役和卡尔迪耶罗战役中失利。这也是他首次遭遇重大策略性失败，并且是此后10年来最后一次战败。
zh.n: 1799年阿卡围城战结束：围城两个月后，拿破仑·波拿巴放弃围攻奥斯曼城市阿卡。此次围城是其埃及战役的转折点，也是他军事生涯早期遭遇的重大失败之一。

en.s: In the Battle of Aspern-Essling (21–22 May 1809), Napoleon attempted a forced crossing of the Danube near Vienna, but the French and their allies were driven back by the Austrians under Archduke Charles. The battle was the first time Napoleon had been personally defeated in over a decade. However, Archduke Charles failed to secure a decisive victory as Napoleon was able to successfully withdraw most of his forces.

zh.s: 阿斯珀恩-埃斯林战役于1809年5月21日至22日进行。拿破仑试图在维也纳附近强渡多瑙河，但法国及其盟军遭到卡尔大公率领的奥地利军队击退。这是十多年来拿破仑首次亲自战败。不过，卡尔大公未能取得决定性胜利，拿破仑成功撤走了大部分军队。

en.s: The first siege of Montevideo (Spanish: primer sitio de Montevideo) took place between May and October 1811, when the troops of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata unsuccessfully besieged the city of Montevideo, still held by Spanish loyalists. In 1810, the May Revolution had forced the Spanish to abandon Buenos Aires, but they held on to the Banda Oriental (present-day Uruguay), as Francisco Javier de Elío moved the headquarters of his Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata to Montevideo.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次蒙得维的亚围城战于1811年5月至10月进行。拉普拉塔联合省军队围攻蒙得维的亚，但未能攻下这座仍由西班牙保王党控制的城市。1810年五月革命迫使西班牙人放弃布宜诺斯艾利斯，但他们仍控制东岸地区（今乌拉圭）；弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·德·埃利奥随后将拉普拉塔总督辖区首府迁至蒙得维的亚。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的围城开始日期。

en.s: In the Battle of Bautzen (20–21 May 1813), a combined Prusso-Russian army, retreating after their defeat at Lützen and massively outnumbered, was pushed back by Napoleon but escaped destruction. Some sources claim that Marshal Michel Ney failed to block their retreat. The Prussians were led by General Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, and the Russians by General Peter Wittgenstein.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 包岑战役于1813年5月20日至21日进行。普鲁士和俄罗斯联军在吕岑战败后撤退，人数远少于法军，随后被拿破仑击退，但没有被歼灭。一些来源称，米歇尔·内伊元帅未能阻止联军撤退。普军由格布哈德·列贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔将军率领，俄军由彼得·维特根施泰因将军率领。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的战役结束日期。

en.s: The Kedopok War, also known as Kepruk Cina ("Attack the Chinese"), was a peasant uprising in Probolinggo, East Java, in May 1813 during British rule in Java. The uprising was launched against the rule of local Chinese landlord Han Kik Ko. Several British military officers present in Probolinggo were also killed in the uprising. Han Kik Ko purchased Probolinggo from the Dutch colonial government in 1811, and levied heavy taxation to finance his purchase.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克多波克战争又称“克普鲁克奇纳”（意为“袭击华人”），是1813年5月爪哇受英国统治期间发生在东爪哇省普罗博林戈的一场农民起义，目标是推翻当地华人地主韩吉克科的统治。起义中有数名驻扎在普罗博林戈的英国军官被杀。韩吉克科于1811年从荷兰殖民政府手中买下普罗博林戈，并征收重税来支付购买费用。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的起义结束日期。

en.s: The Indian Creek Massacre occurred on May 21, 1832 with the attack by a party of Native Americans on a group of United States settlers in LaSalle County, Illinois following a dispute about a settler-constructed dam that prevented fish from reaching a nearby Potawatomi village. The incident coincided with the Black Hawk War, but it was not a direct action of the Sauk leader Black Hawk and conflict with the United States. The removal of the dam was asked, was rejected by the settlers and between 40 and 80 Potawatomis and three Sauks attacked and killed fifteen settlers, including women and children.

zh.s: 印第安溪大屠杀发生于1832年5月21日，起因是一场争端：定居者修建的水坝挡住了鱼群，无法进入附近波塔瓦托米村庄。事件发生时正值黑鹰战争，但这不是萨克族领袖黑鹰直接参与的行动，也不属于他与美国之间的冲突。定居者拒绝拆坝后，40至80名波塔瓦托米人和3名萨克人发动袭击，杀死15名定居者，其中包括妇女和儿童。

en.s: The Plum River raid was a bloodless skirmish that occurred at present-day Savanna, Illinois, on May 21, 1832, as part of the Black Hawk War. Most of the settlement's inhabitants, except for a few defenders, had fled for Galena, Illinois, before the raid happened. A small band of Native Americans, either Sauk or Fox, attacked the settlement while only three of the six defenders were present. The men who were present fell back to the blockhouse and a firefight ensued for about one hour, after which the attackers withdrew. No one was killed or injured during the attack, but in its aftermath Colonel James M.

zh.s: 普拉姆河突袭是一次没有造成人员伤亡的小规模冲突，于 1832 年 5 月 21 日发生在今美国伊利诺伊州萨瓦纳，属于黑鹰战争的一部分。袭击发生前，定居点的大多数居民已逃往伊利诺伊州加利纳，只留下少数守卫。一小队美洲原住民（可能是索克人或福克斯人）袭击了定居点，当时六名守卫中只有三人在场。他们退入碉堡，双方交火约一小时后，袭击者撤退。袭击中无人死伤；事后，詹姆斯·M·斯特罗德上校派遣一支民兵分队前往萨瓦纳。

en.s: The sacking of Lawrence occurred on May 21, 1856, when pro-slavery settlers, led by Douglas County Sheriff Samuel J. Jones, attacked and ransacked Lawrence, Kansas, a town that had been founded by anti-slavery settlers from Massachusetts who were hoping to make Kansas a free state. The incident fueled the irregular conflict in Kansas Territory that later became known as Bleeding Kansas.

zh.s: 1856年5月21日，奴隶制支持者在道格拉斯县警长塞缪尔·J·琼斯率领下，袭击并洗劫了堪萨斯州劳伦斯镇。该镇由来自马萨诸塞州的反奴隶制定居者建立，他们希望堪萨斯成为自由州。这次事件加剧了堪萨斯领地的非正规冲突，后来这场冲突被称为“流血的堪萨斯”。

en.s: The Chilean Revolution of 1859 was the second attempt by the Chilean Liberals to overthrow their country's Conservative government. Like the first attempt in 1851, it ended in failure. 5,000 people were killed during the fighting.

en.s: The Battle of Plains Store was fought on May 21, 1863, in East Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana, during the campaign to capture Port Hudson in the American Civil War. Union troops advancing from Baton Rouge, Louisiana clashed with 600 Confederates at a road junction. The initial Confederate force withdrew, but 400 more Confederates arrived from Port Hudson. Some of the Confederate reinforcement overran Union artillery and routed a Union regiment, but were unable to capture the guns. Union reinforcements advanced to the front, attacked part of the Confederate force and drove them from the field.

zh.s: 普莱恩斯商店之战于1863年5月21日在路易斯安那州东巴吞鲁日堂区发生，是美国内战期间围攻哈德逊港行动的一部分。从巴吞鲁日推进的联邦军在一处道路交叉口遭遇600名邦联军。邦联军先头部队撤退，但后来又有400名士兵从哈德逊港赶来增援。一部分援军冲过联邦军炮兵阵地，并击溃一个联邦军团，但没能夺取火炮。联邦军增援部队随后赶到，进攻邦联军的一部分兵力，将其赶出战场。

en.s: The Battle of Spotsylvania Court House, sometimes more simply referred to as the Battle of Spotsylvania (or the 19th-century spelling Spottsylvania), was the second major battle in Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's 1864 Overland Campaign of the American Civil War. Following the bloody but inconclusive Battle of the Wilderness, Grant's army disengaged from Confederate General Robert E. Lee's army and moved to the southeast, attempting to lure Lee into battle under more favorable conditions. Elements of Lee's army beat the Union army to the critical crossroads of Spotsylvania Court House, Virginia and began entrenching.

zh.t: 斯波茨尔维尼亚法院之战
zh.s: 斯波茨尔维尼亚法院之战是美国内战期间尤利西斯·S·格兰特中将1864年陆上战役中的第二场主要战役，有时简称斯波茨尔维尼亚战役。荒野之战伤亡惨重、未分胜负后，格兰特的军队摆脱罗伯特·E·李将军率领的邦联军，向东南移动，试图把李引到更有利于联邦军的战场。李的部分部队抢先抵达弗吉尼亚州斯波茨尔维尼亚法院的关键路口，并开始挖掘壕沟。

en.s: The Caucasian War or the Caucasus War was a 19th-century military conflict between the Russian Empire and various peoples of the North Caucasus who resisted subjugation during the Russian conquest of the Caucasus. It consisted of a series of military actions waged by the Russian Imperial Army and Cossack settlers against the native inhabitants such as the Adyghe, Abazins, Ubykhs, Chechens, Dagestanis as the Tsars sought to expand.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 高加索战争是19世纪俄罗斯帝国与北高加索各民族之间的军事冲突，这些民族抵抗俄罗斯征服高加索及其统治。战争由俄罗斯帝国军队和哥萨克移民针对当地居民发动的一系列军事行动组成，涉及阿迪格人、阿巴津人、乌比赫人、车臣人和达吉斯坦人等。沙皇试图不断扩张领土。

en.s: The semaine sanglante ("Bloody Week") was a weeklong battle in Paris from 21 to 28 May 1871, during which the French Army recaptured the city from the Communards. This was the final battle of the Paris Commune. Following the Treaty of Frankfurt and France's loss in the Franco-Prussian War, on 18 March the new French government under Prime Minister Adolphe Thiers attempted to remove a large number of cannons from a park in Montmartre, to keep them out of the hands of the more radical soldiers of the Paris National Guard.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “血腥周”是巴黎的一周战斗，发生于1871年5月21日至28日。法国军队在此期间从巴黎公社手中夺回这座城市。这是巴黎公社的最后一场战斗。普法战争中法国战败并签署《法兰克福条约》后，阿道夫·梯也尔领导的新政府于3月18日试图从蒙马特公园移走一批大炮，以免落入巴黎国民自卫军中更激进的士兵手中。

en.s: The Battle of Iquique (Spanish: Batalla de Iquique or Combate Naval de Iquique) was a confrontation that occurred on 21 May 1879, during the naval stage of the War of the Pacific, a conflict between Chile and Peru and Bolivia. The battle took place off the then-Peruvian port of Iquique. The Peruvian ironclad Huáscar, commanded by Miguel Grau Seminario, sank Esmeralda, a Chilean wooden corvette captained by Arturo Prat Chacón, after four hours of combat.

zh.s: 伊基克海战（西班牙语：Batalla de Iquique或Combate Naval de Iquique）于1879年5月21日爆发，是智利、秘鲁和玻利维亚之间太平洋战争海战阶段的一场交战。战场位于当时秘鲁港口伊基克外海。米格尔·格劳·塞米纳里奥指挥的秘鲁铁甲舰“瓦斯卡尔号”经过4小时战斗击沉了智利木壳护卫舰“埃斯梅拉达号”；后者由阿图罗·普拉特·查孔担任舰长。

en.s: The Battle of Punta Gruesa took place on May 21, 1879, during the War of the Pacific between Chile and Peru. This may be labelled as the second part of the Naval Battle of Iquique, although it is described in many sources as a separate battle.

zh.s: 蓬塔格鲁埃萨海战于1879年5月21日爆发，是太平洋战争期间智利与秘鲁之间的一场海战。有些资料将其视为伊基克海战的第二部分，但许多资料把它作为一场独立战役。

en.t: The American Red Cross is established by Clara Barton in Dansville, New York
en.s: The American Red Cross (ARC) is an American nonprofit humanitarian organization that provides emergency assistance, disaster relief, and disaster preparedness education in the United States. Clara Barton founded the organization in 1881 after initially learning of the Red Cross, founded 1863 in Geneva, Switzerland. It is the designated American affiliate of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

zh.t: 美国红十字会在克拉拉·巴顿的倡议下成立
zh.s: 美国红十字会（ARC）是美国的非营利人道组织，在美国提供紧急援助、灾害救济和灾害应对教育。克拉拉·巴顿于1881年创立该组织；此前，她了解到1863年在瑞士日内瓦成立的红十字会。美国红十字会是红十字会与红新月会国际联合会及国际红十字与红新月运动在美国的指定成员组织。

en.t: The Manchester Ship Canal in the United Kingdom is officially opened by Queen Victoria, who later knights its designer Sir Edward Leader Williams
en.s: The Manchester Ship Canal is a 36-mile-long (58 km) inland waterway in North West England that links Manchester to the Irish Sea. Beginning in the Mersey estuary at Eastham, near Ellesmere Port in Cheshire, it generally follows the original routes of the rivers Mersey and Irwell through the historic counties of Cheshire and Lancashire before terminating to the east of Salford Quays near Pomona Docks and a junction with the Bridgewater Canal where it meets the Irwell.

zh.t: 英国曼彻斯特运河正式开放，维多利亚女王为其设计师爱德华·利德·威廉斯爵士授予骑士称号
zh.s: 曼彻斯特运河是英格兰西北部一条长36英里（58公里）的内陆水道，连接曼彻斯特和爱尔兰海。运河始于柴郡埃尔斯米尔港附近的伊斯特姆默西河口，大致沿默西河和厄韦尔河原有河道穿过历史上的柴郡和兰开夏郡，最终在索尔福德码头以东、波莫纳码头附近与布里奇沃特运河交汇，并接入厄韦尔河。

en.s: The 1902 North-West Territories general election, occurred on 21 May 1902 and was the fifth general election in the history of the North-West Territories, Canada. It was held to elect 35 Members of the Legislative Assembly of the North-West Territories. The Liberal-Conservatives led by incumbent North-West Territories Premier Frederick W. A. G. Haultain, received 8,319 votes, taking 21 of 35 seats.

zh.s: 加拿大西北地区于1902年5月21日举行第5次大选，改选地区立法议会35名议员。由西北地区现任总理弗雷德里克·W·A·G·霍尔坦领导的自由保守党获得8,319票，赢得35席中的21席。

en.t: The Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) is founded in Paris
en.s: The Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) (French for 'International Association Football Federation') is an international self-regulatory governing body of association football, beach soccer, and futsal. It was founded on 21 May 1904 to oversee international competition among the national associations of Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, its membership now comprises 211 national associations.

zh.s: 国际足球联合会（FIFA）是足球、沙滩足球和五人制足球的国际管理机构。它于1904年5月21日成立，负责协调比利时、丹麦、法国、德国、荷兰、西班牙、瑞典和瑞士等国家协会之间的国际赛事。FIFA总部位于瑞士苏黎世，目前有211个国家协会成员。

en.s: The Treaty of Ciudad Juárez was a peace treaty signed between the President of Mexico, Porfirio Díaz, and the revolutionary Francisco Madero on May 21, 1911. The treaty put an end to the fighting between forces supporting Madero and those of Díaz and thus concluded the initial phase of the Mexican Revolution.

zh.s: 华雷斯城条约是墨西哥总统波菲里奥·迪亚斯与革命者弗朗西斯科·马德罗于1911年5月21日签署的和平条约。该条约结束了支持马德罗和迪亚斯的军队之间的战斗，也结束了墨西哥革命的第一阶段。

en.s: The Hakkari expedition of 1916 (21 May–29 June 1916) was a number of raids during World War I conducted by the Assyrian volunteers against local Hakkari Kurdish tribesmen who the year prior, with the help of the Ottoman Empire, expelled the Assyrians from Hakkari, resulting in their settling in Russian-controlled Urmia and its surroundings.

en.s: The Great Atlanta Fire of 1917 began just after noon on 21 May 1917 in the Old Fourth Ward of Atlanta, Georgia. It is unclear just how the fire started, but it was fueled by hot temperatures and strong winds which propelled the fire. The fire, which burned for nearly 10 hours, destroyed 300 acres (120 ha) and 1,900 structures displacing over 10,000 people.

zh.s: 1917年5月21日中午刚过，佐治亚州亚特兰大老第四区发生大火。火灾起因不明，但高温和强风助长了火势。大火持续近10小时，烧毁120公顷（300英亩）土地上的1,900座建筑，造成1万多人无家可归。

en.s: The Battle of Alexander Fort (or Battle of Tyub-Karaganskom), was a naval battle fought in the Caspian Sea during the Russian Civil War at the naval military base of Fort Alexandrovsky.

zh.s: 亚历山德罗夫斯基堡战役又称丘布-卡拉甘战役，是俄罗斯内战期间发生在里海亚历山德罗夫斯基堡海军基地的一场海战。

en.t: The opera Doktor Faust, unfinished when composer Ferruccio Busoni died, is premiered in Dresden
en.s: Doktor Faust is an opera by Ferruccio Busoni with a German libretto by the composer, based on the myth of Faust. Busoni worked on the opera, which he intended as his masterpiece, between 1916 and 1924, but it was still incomplete at the time of his death. His pupil Philipp Jarnach finished it. More recently, in 1982, Antony Beaumont completed the opera using sketches by Busoni that were previously thought to have been lost.

zh.t: 费鲁乔·布索尼未完成的歌剧《浮士德博士》在德累斯顿首演
zh.s: 《浮士德博士》是费鲁乔·布索尼创作的一部歌剧，德语剧本也由他撰写，故事取材于浮士德传说。布索尼于1916年至1924年间创作这部歌剧，并将其视为自己的杰作，但去世时作品仍未完成。其学生菲利普·亚尔纳赫完成了歌剧。1982年，安东尼·博蒙特根据此前被认为遗失的布索尼草稿完成了另一个版本。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Warringah on 21 May 1927. This was triggered by the resignation of Nationalist MP Sir Granville Ryrie to become Australian High Commissioner to the United Kingdom. The by-election was won by Nationalist candidate Archdale Parkhill.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院沃林加选区于1927年5月21日举行补选。民族党议员格兰维尔·赖里爵士辞职，改任澳大利亚驻英国高级专员，因此举行补选。民族党候选人阿奇代尔·帕克希尔获胜。

en.s: The Changsha coup was a mutiny in Changsha on the evening of May 21, 1927. It was led by Xu Keqiang (許克祥), a regiment commander under General Tang Shengzhi. Up to "several thousands" of peasants were killed in the coup.On January 26, 1923, Sun Yat-sen and Soviet Deputy Foreign Minister Adolph Joffe issued a joint statement and adopted a policy of alliance with Russia and tolerance of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).
en.n: The Changsha coup was a mutiny in Changsha on the evening of May 21, 1927.

zh.s: 长沙事变是1927年5月21日晚在长沙发生的一场兵变，由许克祥领导，他当时是唐生智将军部下的一名团长。事变中有多达数千名农民遇害。1923年1月26日，孙中山与苏联副外交人民委员阿道夫·越飞发表联合声明，确立联俄、容共政策。
zh.n: 长沙事变是1927年5月21日晚在长沙发生的一场兵变。

en.s: An election for the leadership of the United Party was held on 21 May 1930 to choose the next leader of the party. The election was won by Hurunui MP and co-deputy leader of the party George Forbes.

zh.s: 联合党于1930年5月21日举行领袖选举，选出下一任党魁。赫鲁努伊选区议员、该党两位副领袖之一乔治·福布斯赢得选举。

en.s: The Battle of Arras took place on 21 May 1940, during the Battle of France in the Second World War. Following the German invasion of the Low Countries on 10 May, French and British forces advanced into Belgium. The German campaign plan Fall Gelb (Case Yellow) had evolved into a decoy operation in the Netherlands and Belgium, with the main effort through the Ardennes.

zh.s: 阿拉斯战役于1940年5月21日爆发，是第二次世界大战法国战役的一部分。5月10日德军入侵低地国家后，法国和英国军队推进至比利时。德军的“黄色方案”最初演变为在荷兰和比利时实施的佯攻，主攻方向则经由阿登地区。

en.s: Convoy ON 92 was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the Second World War. It was the 92nd of the numbered series of ON convoys Outbound from the British Isles to North America. The ships departed from Liverpool on 6 May 1942 and were joined on 7 May by Mid-Ocean Escort Force Group A-3.

zh.s: ON 92船队是第二次世界大战期间的一支商船队，属于编号为ON系列的第92支慢速船队，从英国群岛出发前往北美。船队于1942年5月6日从利物浦启航，5月7日与大洋中部护航力量A-3编队会合。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框中所列的船队结束日期。

en.s: The West Loch Disaster was a maritime accident during World War II at Pearl Harbor U.S. Naval Base in Hawaii. The incident, which occurred just after 3 p.m. on Sunday, 21 May 1944, began following an explosion in a staging area for Landing Ships, Tank (LSTs) and other amphibious assault ships in West Loch. A fire quickly spread among the ships being prepared for Operation Forager, the invasion of the Japanese-held Mariana Islands.

zh.s: 西洛赫灾难是第二次世界大战期间发生在夏威夷珍珠港美国海军基地的一起海上事故。1944年5月21日星期日下午3时刚过，停泊在西洛赫、准备参加“觅食者行动”（入侵日军控制的马里亚纳群岛）的坦克登陆舰及其他两栖攻击舰集结区发生爆炸。火势迅速在舰船间蔓延。

en.s: The Battle of Wakde (Operation Straight Line) was part of the New Guinea campaign of World War II. It was fought between the United States and Japan from 17 May 1944 to 21 May 1944 in Dutch New Guinea (now Papua, in Indonesia). The operation involved an assault on the Japanese-held Wakde island group by a reinforced US infantry battalion, which was transported from a beachhead the Allied troops had established around Arara, on the mainland, the previous day.

zh.s: 瓦克德岛战役又称“直线行动”，是第二次世界大战新几内亚战役的一部分，于1944年5月17日至21日在荷属新几内亚（今印度尼西亚巴布亚省）进行。盟军以一支加强步兵营突袭日军控制的瓦克德群岛。部队从盟军前一天在大陆阿拉拉周边建立的滩头阵地出发。

en.t: Attack on the NKVD Camp in Rembertów
en.s: On May 21, 1945, a unit of the Home Army (Armia Krajowa, AK), led by Colonel Edward Wasilewski, attacked a Soviet NKVD camp located in Rembertów on the eastern outskirts of Warsaw. The Russians incarcerated there many hundreds of Polish citizens; members of the Home Army and underground fighters, whom they were systematically deporting to Siberia. However, this action of the pro-independence Polish resistance freed all Polish political prisoners from the camp.

zh.t: 突袭伦贝尔图夫内务人民委员部营地
zh.s: 1945年5月21日，波兰家乡军（Armia Krajowa，AK）的一支部队在爱德华·瓦西莱夫斯基上校率领下，袭击了位于华沙东郊伦贝尔图夫的苏联内务人民委员部（NKVD）营地。苏方在此关押了数百名波兰公民，包括家乡军成员和地下抵抗人员，并有计划地将他们遣送到西伯利亚。这次行动解救了营地里所有波兰政治犯。

en.s: The 9th Street Art Exhibition of Paintings and Sculpture is the official title artist Franz Kline hand-lettered onto the poster he designed for the Ninth Street Show (May 21-June 10, 1951). Now considered historic, the artist-led exhibition marked the formal debut of Abstract Expressionism, and the first American art movement with international influence.

zh.s: 第九街绘画与雕塑艺术展是艺术家弗朗茨·克莱因亲笔写在海报上的正式名称。展览也称“第九街展”，于1951年5月21日至6月10日举行。如今，这场由艺术家发起的展览被视为具有历史意义，它标志着抽象表现主义正式登场，也是首个具有国际影响力的美国艺术运动。

en.s: The 1955 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1954–55 DFB-Pokal, the 12th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 21 May 1955 at the Eintracht-Stadion in Braunschweig. Karlsruher SC won the match 3–2 against Schalke 04, to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1955年德国杯决赛决出了1954—55赛季德国杯冠军，这是该项淘汰赛第12个赛季。比赛于1955年5月21日在不伦瑞克的恩特拉赫特体育场举行。卡尔斯鲁厄以3比2击败沙尔克04，首次夺冠。

en.s: By-elections were held in the Barbadian constituencies of St Joseph and St John on 21 May 1958.

en.s: The 1962 Iraq Central FA Altruism Cup was the 1st edition of the Iraq Central FA Perseverance Cup. The match was contested between the winners and runners-up of the 1961–62 edition of the Iraq Central FA Premier League, Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya and Al-Kuliya Al-Askariya respectively. Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya won the game 4–2.

zh.s: 1962年伊拉克中央足协友谊杯是伊拉克中央足协坚忍杯的首届赛事。参赛双方是1961—62赛季伊拉克中央足协超级联赛的冠军和亚军，分别为空军俱乐部和军事学院俱乐部。空军俱乐部以4比2获胜。

en.s: An election to choose the third President of Israel was held in the Knesset on 21 May 1963 following the death of the county's second president, Yitzhak Ben-Zvi on 23 April. Between Ben-Zvi's death and the winner of the election, Zalman Shazar, taking office on the day of the vote, Knesset speaker Kadish Luz served as acting president.

zh.s: 以色列议会于1963年5月21日举行选举，选出第三任总统。第二任总统伊扎克·本-兹维于4月23日去世后，议长卡迪什·卢兹担任代理总统，直到当选者扎尔曼·夏扎尔在投票当天就任。

en.s: Operation Limpieza took place during the Dominican Civil War in May 1965. The objective of the operation was to eliminate rebel resistance in the northern part of Santo Domingo. Operation Limpieza (Cleanup) involved 16 tanks and over 1,000 troops of the military junta. The offensive began on 13 May. The attacking infantry was well equipped with mortars, bazookas, and 37 mm cannons, while the defending civilians were armed with nothing heavier than machine guns.

zh.s: “清扫行动”发生在1965年5月的多米尼加内战期间，目标是消灭圣多明各北部的叛军抵抗力量。多米尼加军政府投入16辆坦克和1,000多名士兵。攻势于5月13日开始。进攻步兵装备精良，配有迫击炮、火箭筒和37毫米火炮；守城平民手中最重的武器则是机枪。

en.s: The 1967 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 21, 1967, that saw Olympique Lyonnais defeat FC Sochaux-Montbéliard 3–1 thanks to goals by Angel Rambert, André Perrin and Fleury Di Nallo.

zh.s: 1967年法国杯决赛于1967年5月21日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦奥林匹克体育场举行。里昂奥林匹克以3比1击败索肖，进球者是安热尔·朗贝尔、安德烈·佩兰和弗勒里·迪纳洛。

en.s: The 1969 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was the final football match of the 1968–69 European Cup Winners' Cup and the ninth European Cup Winners' Cup final. It was contested between Barcelona of Spain and Slovan Bratislava of Czechoslovakia, and was held at St. Jakob Stadium in Basel, Switzerland. Slovan won the match 3–2 thanks to goals from Ľudovít Cvetler, Vladimír Hrivnák and Ján Čapkovič.

zh.s: 1969年欧洲优胜者杯决赛是1968—69赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第9届决赛。对阵双方是西班牙巴塞罗那和捷克斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万，比赛在瑞士巴塞尔圣雅各布体育场举行。斯洛万以3比2获胜，进球者是卢多维特·茨维特勒、弗拉迪米尔·赫里夫纳克和扬·恰普科维奇。

en.s: The Yuba City bus disaster occurred on May 21, 1976 in Martinez, California. A 1950 Crown bus operated by Student Transportation Lines, Inc. had been chartered to carry the Yuba City High School a cappella choir from Yuba City to Miramonte High School in Orinda for a friendship day involving the choirs of the two schools. The accident occurred at 10:55 a.m., as the driver took the Marina Vista (exit 56) off-ramp from I-680 southbound from the Benicia–Martinez Bridge. The driver was unfamiliar with this bus, and mistakenly thought the low air pressure warning (for the air brakes) was a warning of low engine oil pressure.

zh.s: 1976年5月21日，一辆1950年款克朗牌巴士在加利福尼亚州马丁内斯发生事故。东海岸航空服务公司（运营名称为Executive Airlines）运营这辆巴士，并受包车委托接送尤巴城高中无伴奏合唱团，从尤巴城前往奥林达的米拉蒙特高中，参加两校合办的友谊日活动。当天上午10时55分，司机从贝尼西亚—马丁内斯大桥驶上680号州际公路南向路段的滨海景观出口匝道时发生事故。司机不熟悉这辆巴士，误把气压过低警告（提示气刹故障）当成机油压力过低警告。

en.s: The 1977 FA Cup final was the final match of the 1976–77 FA Cup, the 96th season of England's premier cup football competition. The match was played on 21 May 1977 at Wembley Stadium, London, and it was contested by Liverpool and Manchester United. United won the game 2–1. All three goals came in a five-minute period early in the second half.

zh.s: 1977年英格兰足总杯决赛是1976—77赛季英格兰足总杯的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第96个赛季的决赛。比赛于1977年5月21日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由利物浦对阵曼联。曼联以2比1获胜。下半场开场后的5分钟内，双方打进了全部3个进球。

en.s: The Battle of San Carlos was an aerial and naval battle that lasted from 21 to 25 May 1982 during the British landings on the shores of San Carlos Water (which became known as "Bomb Alley") in the Falklands War. Low-flying land-based Argentine fighter jets made repeated attacks on ships of the British Task Force.

zh.s: 圣卡洛斯海战是一场空战和海战，于1982年5月21日至25日在圣卡洛斯水域沿岸的英军登陆期间进行。该水域后来被称为“炸弹巷”。阿根廷陆基战斗机低空反复攻击英国特遣舰队的舰船，这场战斗是马岛战争的一部分。

en.s: The 1983 Scottish Cup Final was played on 21 May 1983 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 108th Scottish Cup. Aberdeen and Rangers contested the match, Aberdeen won the match 1–0, thanks to Eric Black's extra time goal. Aberdeen had already won the Cup Winners' Cup ten days earlier, making the Scottish Cup their second trophy of the season.

zh.s: 1983年苏格兰杯决赛于1983年5月21日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，是第108届苏格兰杯决赛。阿伯丁对阵流浪者，并以1比0获胜，埃里克·布莱克在加时赛中打进制胜球。阿伯丁在10天前已赢得欧洲优胜者杯，因此苏格兰杯是球队本赛季的第二座奖杯。

en.s: The assassination of Rajiv Gandhi, the ex-Prime Minister of India, occurred as a result of a suicide bombing in Sriperumbudur, near Chennai, in Tamil Nadu, India on 21 May 1991. At least 14 others were also killed. It was carried out by Thenmozhi Rajaratnam, also known as Dhanu. The attack was blamed on the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE), a militant organization from Sri Lanka; at the time India had just ended its involvement, through the Indian Peace Keeping Force, in the Sri Lankan Civil War. Subsequent accusations of conspiracy have been addressed by two commissions of inquiry and have brought down at least one national government.

zh.s: 印度前总理拉吉夫·甘地于1991年5月21日在印度泰米尔纳德邦斯里佩鲁姆布杜尔（靠近金奈）遭自杀式爆炸袭击身亡，另有至少14人遇难。袭击者是特恩莫日·拉贾拉特南，又名达努。袭击被归咎于斯里兰卡武装组织泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织（LTTE）。当时，印度刚结束印度维和部队在斯里兰卡内战中的行动。此后两项调查委员会处理了有关阴谋的指控，这些指控至少导致一个中央政府垮台。

en.s: The 1994 Scottish Cup final was the final match of the 1993–94 Scottish Cup competition, the 109th edition of the most important cup competition in Scottish football. It was played between Dundee United and Rangers at Hampden Park, Glasgow, on 21 May 1994. Dundee United won the game 1–0, with a goal by Craig Brewster. Following a mix-up between Rangers' goalkeeper Ally Maxwell and Dave McPherson, United's Christian Dailly rolled a cross-shot across goal.

zh.s: 1994年苏格兰杯决赛是1993—94赛季的最后一场比赛，也是苏格兰足球最重要的杯赛第109届决赛。比赛于1994年5月21日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行，由邓迪联对阵流浪者。邓迪联凭克雷格·布鲁斯特的进球以1比0获胜。流浪者门将阿利·麦克斯韦和戴夫·麦克弗森配合失误后，邓迪联的克里斯蒂安·戴利从边路传中并完成射门。

en.s: The 1993–94 FA Trophy Final, known as the 1994 Vauxhall FA Trophy Final for sponsorship reasons, was the final match of the 1993–94 FA Trophy. It was the 25th season of the competition for teams from the Conference and other semi-professional teams below this level. The match was held on Saturday 21 May 1994 at Wembley Stadium, London, and was contested by Woking and Runcorn.

zh.s: 1993—94赛季英格兰足总锦标赛决赛因赞助冠名也称“沃克斯豪尔足总锦标赛决赛”，是该赛季足总锦标赛的最后一场比赛。该赛事第25个赛季面向全国联赛球队和该级别以下的其他半职业球队。比赛于1994年5月21日星期六在伦敦温布利球场举行，由沃金对阵朗科恩。

en.s: On May 21, 1995, regional elections were held in Belgium, to choose representatives in the regional councils of Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels and the German-speaking Community of Belgium. It also was the first time elections were held for the Flemish and the Walloon Council. The regional elections were held on the same day as the federal election.

zh.s: 比利时于1995年5月21日举行区域选举，选出佛兰德、瓦隆、布鲁塞尔和比利时德语社群区域议会的代表。这也是首次选举佛兰德议会和瓦隆议会。区域选举与联邦选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Slamboree '95: A Legends' Reunion was the third Slamboree professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on May 21, 1995, from the Bayfront Arena in St. Petersburg, Florida in the United States. Eric Bischoff filled in on commentary for Tony Schiavone at this event; Schiavone took time off to undergo neck surgery.

zh.s: 《Slamboree 95：传奇重聚》是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）主办的第三届《Slamboree》付费电视赛事，于1995年5月21日在美国佛罗里达州圣彼得堡的海滨竞技场举行。托尼·斯基亚沃尼休假接受颈部手术，因此由埃里克·比肖夫代替他担任本场赛事解说。

en.t: 1995 Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand co-leadership elections
en.s: The 1995 Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand co-leadership elections were elections that took place on 21 May 1995 to determine the future leadership of the Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand. The elections were held at the party's annual conference at Tauhara, near Taupō. The conference determined the party would use a gender-based co-leadership model and elected Rod Donald and Jeanette Fitzsimons to fill those roles.

zh.t: 1995年新西兰绿党联合领袖选举
zh.s: 新西兰绿党于1995年5月21日举行联合领袖选举，决定该党未来的领导班子。选举在陶波附近的陶哈拉举行，会议决定采用男女联合领袖制，并选出罗德·唐纳德和珍妮特·菲茨西蒙斯担任联合领袖。

en.s: The 1995 Welsh Cup final, was the 108th in the competition. It was contested by Wrexham and Cardiff City at the Cardiff Arms Park, Cardiff.

en.s: On May 21, 1996, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. Incumbent mayor Vera Katz was re-elected. Portland uses a nonpartisan system for local elections, in which all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political party affiliation. All candidates meeting the qualifications competed in a blanket primary election on May 21, 1996.

zh.t: 1996年俄勒冈州波特兰市长选举

en.s: The 1996 Portland City Commission elections were held on May 21, 1996, and November 5, 1996, to elect three positions on the Portland, Oregon City Council. Jim Francesconi and Charlie Hales won positions 1 and 4, respectively, after a primary and runoff election. Erik Sten won election to position 2 during a special general election due to Earl Blumenauer's election to the US House of Representatives.

en.s: Elections to Belfast City Council were held on 21 May 1997 on the same day as the other Northern Irish local government elections. The election used nine district electoral areas to elect a total of 51 councillors, most representing the more heavily populated north and west. Unionists lost overall control of Belfast City Council for the first time in its history, with Alliance holding the balance of power between unionists and nationalists.

en.s: Bacharuddin Jusuf Habibie (Indonesian: [bahaˌrudin ˌjusuf haˈbibi] ; 25 June 1936 – 11 September 2019) was an Indonesian statesman, engineer, scientist and inventor who served as the third president of Indonesia from 1998 to 1999. A little over two months after his inauguration as the seventh vice president in March 1998, he succeeded Suharto, who resigned after 32 years in office, thereby being the country's first vice president to assume the presidency intra-term.

zh.t: B·J·哈比比就任印度尼西亚总统
zh.s: 巴查鲁丁·优素福·哈比比（印度尼西亚语发音：[bahaˌrudin ˌjusuf haˈbibi]；1936年6月25日—2019年9月11日）是印度尼西亚政治家、工程师、科学家和发明家，1998年至1999年担任印度尼西亚第三任总统。1998年3月就任第七任副总统两个多月后，苏哈托在执政32年后辞职，哈比比接任总统，成为该国首位在任期中途接任总统的副总统。

en.t: Indonesian president Suharto resigned after a collapse of support for his presidency amid economic and political crises, ending 32 years in power
en.s: Suharto (8 June 1921 – 27 January 2008) was an Indonesian general and politician who served as the second and longest-serving president of Indonesia from 1967 to 1998. Suharto was born in Kemusuk, near the city of Yogyakarta, during the Dutch colonial era. He grew up in humble circumstances. His Javanese Muslim parents divorced not long after his birth, and he lived with foster parents for much of his childhood.

zh.t: 印度尼西亚总统苏哈托因经济和政治危机导致支持率崩溃而辞职，结束32年执政
zh.s: 苏哈托（1921年6月8日—2008年1月27日）是印度尼西亚将军和政治家，1967年至1998年担任该国第二任总统，也是任期最长的总统。他出生于荷兰殖民时期日惹附近的克穆苏克，成长环境清贫。其爪哇穆斯林父母在他出生后不久离婚，他童年大部分时间由养父母抚养。

en.s: Judgment Day (2000) was the first annual Judgment Day professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). en.t: 2000 Executive Airlines British Aerospace Jetstream crash
en.s: On May 21, 2000, a British Aerospace BAe-3101 Jetstream 3101 operated by East Coast Aviation Services (known operationally as Executive Airlines) crashed into mountainous terrain in Bear Creek Township, Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. The plane was carrying 17 professional gamblers returning home from Caesar's Palace Casino in Atlantic City, New Jersey, along with 2 crew members. It was chartered by Caesar's Palace (New Jersey). All 19 passengers and crew on board were killed on impact. This accident, alongside the accident of Aerocaribe Flight 7831 were the accidents with the most fatalities involving the Jetstream 3101 airliner. An investigation was conducted by the National Transportation Safety Board.

Arsenal became the first team to win the FA Cup via a penalty shoot-out, after neither side managed to score in the initial 90 minutes or in 30 minutes of extra time.

en.s: Kingda Ka was a hydraulically-launched steel roller coaster located at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, New Jersey, United States. Manufactured by Intamin and designed by Werner Stengel, Kingda Ka opened as the tallest and fastest roller coaster in the world on May 21, 2005, surpassing Top Thrill Dragster at Cedar Point. Although both featured similar designs, Kingda Ka's layout added an airtime hill on the return portion of the track.

en.s: An independence referendum was held in Montenegro on 21 May 2006. It was approved by 55.5% of voters, narrowly passing the 55% threshold. By 23 May, preliminary referendum results were recognized by all five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, indicating widespread international recognition of Montenegro once independence would be formally declared. On 31 May the referendum commission officially confirmed the results of the referendum, verifying that 55.5% of the population of Montenegrin voters had voted in favor of independence. Because voters met the controversial threshold requirement of 55% approval set by the European Union, the referendum was incorporated into a declaration of independence during a special parliamentary session on 31 May.

en.s: The 2006 Football League Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 21 May 2006 at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, between Leeds United and Watford. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Championship, the second tier of English football, to the FA Premiership, the top tier.

zh.t: 2006年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2006年英格兰足球冠军联赛升级附加赛决赛于2006年5月21日在威尔士加的夫千禧球场举行，由利兹联对阵沃特福德，决出从英格兰足球第二级别冠军联赛升入顶级英超的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2006 King of the Ring was the 17th edition of the King of the Ring tournament produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). The tournament was held between April 14 and May 21, 2006 and was the first tournament conducted since the 2002 tournament which was won by Brock Lesnar.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2006年《擂台之王》是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）主办的第17届年度“擂台之王”锦标赛。比赛于2006年4月14日至5月21日举行。这是自2002年以来首次举办该锦标赛；2002年赛事由布洛克·莱斯纳获胜。

en.s: On May 21, 2008, Tuareg rebels from the Niger-Mali Tuareg Alliance attacked Malian forces in Abeïbara, Kidal Region, Mali, but were repulsed.

zh.s: 2008年5月21日，尼日尔—马里图阿雷格联盟的图阿雷格叛军袭击了马里基达尔地区阿贝伊巴拉的政府军，但被击退。

en.s: The 2008 UEFA Champions League final was a football match that took place on 21 May 2008 at the Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow, Russia, to determine the winner of the 2007–08 UEFA Champions League. It was contested by Manchester United and Chelsea, making it an all-English final for the first time in the history of the competition; it was only the third time that two clubs from the same country had contested the final, after 2000 and 2003.

zh.s: 2008年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2008年5月21日在俄罗斯莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，决出2007—08赛季冠军。对阵双方是曼联和切尔西，这是赛事史上首次出现全英格兰球队参加的决赛，也是第三次由同一国家的两支球队争夺冠军，此前分别发生在2000年和2003年。

en.s: The 2009 Algerian Cup final was the 45th final of the Algerian Cup. The final took place on May 21, 2009, at Stade Mustapha Tchaker in Blida with kick-off at 16:00. CR Belouizdad beat CA Bordj Bou Arreridj 2–1 on penalties to win their six Algerian Cup. The competition winners are awarded a berth in the 2010 CAF Confederation Cup.

zh.s: 2009年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是该赛事第45届决赛，于2009年5月21日16时在卜利达的穆斯塔法·查克尔体育场举行。贝鲁伊兹达德红星与阿尔及利亚边境青年队在常规时间后战平，贝鲁伊兹达德红星在点球大战中以2比1获胜，第6次夺得阿尔及利亚杯。冠军球队将获得参加2010年非洲足联联合会杯的资格。

en.s: The 2009 Danish Cup final was the final and deciding match of the 2008–09 Danish Cup. It took place on Thursday 21 May 2009 at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen. The then-leader in the Superliga F.C. Copenhagen met AaB, who was in 7th. F.C. Copenhagen won the match 1–0 on a 31st-minute goal by midfielder William Kvist, securing the club their fourth cup title after they won in 1995, 1997 and 2004.

zh.s: 2009年丹麦杯决赛是2008—09赛季丹麦杯决出冠军的最后一场比赛，于2009年5月21日星期四在哥本哈根帕肯球场举行。联赛领头羊哥本哈根对阵排名第7的奥尔堡。哥本哈根以1比0获胜，中场球员威廉·奎斯特在第31分钟进球。这是哥本哈根第4次夺冠，此前曾于1995年、1997年和2004年获胜。

en.t: K-1 World Grand Prix 2010 in Bucharest
en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2010 in Bucharest, billed as Europe's GP, was a kickboxing event held by the K-1 organization in association with the Local Kombat promotion on Friday, May 21, 2010 at the Romexpo Dome in Bucharest, Romania.

zh.s: 2010年布加勒斯特K-1世界大奖赛因宣传名称也称“欧洲大奖赛”，是K-1组织与当地格斗推广机构Local Kombat联合举办的踢拳赛事，于2010年5月21日星期五在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特Romexpo圆顶馆举行。

en.s: The 2010–11 DFB-Pokal season came to a close on 21 May 2011 when Duisburg played against Schalke 04 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. For the first time since 2004, a team from the 2. Bundesliga reached the final. Schalke 04 won the cup for the fifth time after defeating Duisburg 5–0.

zh.s: 2010—11赛季德国杯于2011年5月21日落幕，杜伊斯堡在柏林奥林匹克体育场对阵沙尔克04。自2004年以来，首次有一支德乙球队闯入决赛。沙尔克04以5比0击败杜伊斯堡，第5次赢得德国杯。

en.s: The 2011 Conference Premier play-off final, known as the 2011 Blue Square Bet Premier play-off final for sponsorship purposes, was a football match between AFC Wimbledon and Luton Town on 21 May 2011 at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester. It was the ninth Conference Premier play-off final and was played in Manchester due to a conflict with the UEFA Champions League final.

zh.t: 2011年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2011年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助冠名也称“蓝方块投注超级联赛附加赛决赛”。比赛于2011年5月21日在曼彻斯特的阿提哈德球场举行，由AFC温布尔登对阵卢顿镇。这是第9届全国联赛升级附加赛决赛。由于比赛时间与欧洲冠军联赛决赛冲突，比赛安排在曼彻斯特举行。

en.s: Supercard of Honor VI was a professional wrestling event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the 6th Supercard of Honor and took place on May 21, 2011 at Frontier Fieldhouse in Chicago Ridge, Illinois.

zh.s: 荣誉超级卡VI是荣誉摔角联盟（ROH）主办的职业摔角赛事，于2011年5月21日在伊利诺伊州芝加哥岭市的Frontier Fieldhouse举行。这是第6届荣誉超级卡赛事。

en.s: The 2011 Heineken Cup Final was the final match of the 2010–11 Heineken Cup, the 16th season of Europe's top club rugby union competition. The match was played on 21 May 2011 at Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, Wales. The match was contested by Northampton Saints of England and Leinster of Ireland, the second Heineken Cup final for each club. Leinster won the match 33–22 after being 22–6 down at half-time.

zh.s: 2011年喜力杯决赛是2010—11赛季喜力杯的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲顶级俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第16个赛季。比赛于2011年5月21日在威尔士加的夫千禧球场举行，由英格兰北安普顿圣徒对阵爱尔兰伦斯特。两队此前都只参加过一次喜力杯决赛。半场时伦斯特以6比22落后，但最终以33比22获胜。

en.s: The 2011 Scottish Cup Final was the 126th final of the Scottish Cup, Scottish football's most prestigious knockout association football competition. The match took place at Hampden Park on 21 May 2011 and was played by Scottish Premier League clubs Motherwell and Celtic. It was Celtic's 54th Scottish Cup final and Motherwell's seventh. Celtic won the title after they defeated Motherwell 3–0.

zh.s: 2011年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事第126届决赛，也是苏格兰足球最重要的淘汰赛决赛。比赛于2011年5月21日在汉普顿公园举行，由苏格兰超级联赛球队马瑟韦尔和凯尔特人对阵。这是凯尔特人第54次、马瑟韦尔第7次闯入决赛。凯尔特人以3比0获胜。

en.s: The 2011 FA Women's Cup final was the 41st final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 18th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal Ladies and Bristol Academy on 21 May 2011 at Ricoh Arena in Coventry. Holders Arsenal made its 11th final win.

zh.s: 2011年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该赛事第41届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛。此前已有18届决赛由英格兰足总直接主办。比赛于2011年5月21日在考文垂理光球场举行，由阿森纳女足对阵布里斯托尔学院。卫冕冠军阿森纳第11次赢得决赛。

en.s: The 2011 Belgian Cup final, named Cofidis Cup after the sponsor, was played on 21 May 2011 between Westerlo and Standard Liège. It was the sixth time Standard Liège won the Belgian Cup, 18 years having passed since their last trophy in the competition.

zh.s: 2011年比利时杯决赛因赞助商冠名也称“科菲迪斯杯决赛”，于2011年5月21日举行，由韦斯特洛对阵标准列日。这是标准列日第6次赢得比利时杯，距离该队上一次夺冠已过去18年。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Seychelles between 19 and 21 May 2011, commencing on the Outer Islands on 19 May, with Inner Islands voting on 20 May and Mahé on 21 May. The result was a victory for incumbent President James Michel of the Seychelles People's Progressive Front, who received 55% of the vote in the first round.

zh.s: 塞舌尔于2011年5月19日至21日举行总统选举。外岛于5月19日开始投票，内岛于5月20日投票，马埃岛于5月21日投票。塞舌尔人民进步阵线候选人、时任总统詹姆斯·米歇尔获胜，在第一轮获得55%的选票。

en.s: The 2011 Challenge de France final was the 10th final of France's female football cup competition.

zh.s: 2011年法国杯女子足球决赛是法国女子足球杯赛的第10届决赛。

en.s: On 21 May 2012, a suicide bomber detonated an explosive belt among groups of Yemeni soldiers rehearsing for the annual Unity Day military parade in Sanaa, Yemen. An 18-year-old soldier recruited as a suicide bomber entered al-Sabeen Square in uniform and joined his Central Security Organization brigade midway through the rehearsal. As the soldiers were passing by the parade view stand, the bomber detonated his explosive belt. The attack, which unsuccessfully attempted to target Yemen's Defense Minister Mohammed Nasser Ahmed, killed at least 96 soldiers and wounded 222, making it one of the worst in Yemen's history.

zh.s: 2012年5月21日，一名自杀式袭击者在也门萨那引爆炸弹腰带，袭击正在为年度统一日阅兵彩排的也门士兵。袭击者是一名18岁的士兵，受人招募执行自杀式袭击。他穿着制服进入萨比因广场，趁彩排进行时加入中央安全组织的队伍；士兵经过阅兵观礼台时，他引爆炸弹腰带。袭击者试图袭击也门国防部长穆罕默德·纳赛尔·艾哈迈德，但没有得逞。袭击至少造成96名士兵死亡、222人受伤，是也门历史上伤亡最惨重的袭击之一。

en.s: The Qafa e Vishës bus accident occurred on 21 May 2012, at Qafa e Vishës (Albanian pronunciation: [cafa ɛ viʃəs]) near Himarë, Albania, when a bus plunged 80 metres (260 ft) off a cliff. Most of the victims were students of Aleksandër Xhuvani University of Elbasan. The driver is also believed to have been killed. The students were travelling from Elbasan to Saranda.

zh.s: 维沙山口巴士事故于2012年5月21日在阿尔巴尼亚希马拉附近发生。一辆巴士从悬崖坠下80米（260英尺）。多数遇难者是埃尔巴桑亚历山大·朱瓦尼大学的学生，他们当时从埃尔巴桑前往萨兰达。司机也被认为在事故中丧生。

en.s: An election was held on March 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Los Angeles. No candidate received a majority of the primary votes to be elected outright, and the top two finishers, Eric Garcetti and Wendy Greuel advanced to a runoff vote. On May 21, 2013, Garcetti was elected mayor with a majority of the votes in the runoff.

zh.s: 洛杉矶于2013年3月5日举行市长选举初选。无人得票过半直接当选，得票前两名埃里克·加塞蒂和温迪·格鲁尔进入决选。加塞蒂于2013年5月21日在决选中以多数票当选市长。

en.s: The 2014 Slovenian Cup final was the final match of the 2013–14 Slovenian Cup, the 23rd edition of the Slovenian Football Cup, the top knockout tournament of Slovenian football and the second most important football competition in the country after the Slovenian PrvaLiga championship. The match was played on Wednesday, 21 May 2014 at the Bonifika Stadium in Koper, Slovenia and was won by Gorica who defeated Maribor with the score 2–0.

zh.s: 2014年斯洛文尼亚杯决赛是2013—14赛季斯洛文尼亚足球杯决赛，也是该项赛事第23届决赛。斯洛文尼亚杯是该国顶级淘汰赛，仅次于斯洛文尼亚甲级联赛冠军赛。比赛于2014年5月21日星期三在科佩尔的博尼菲卡体育场举行。戈里察以2比0击败马里博尔，夺得冠军。

en.s: On 21 May 2014, a Taiwanese man carried out a stabbing spree targeting random civilians on a Taipei Metro C321 train near Jiangzicui Station, resulting in four deaths and 24 injuries. It was the first fatal attack on the city's subway system since operations began in 1996. The attacker, 21-year-old Cheng Chieh, was arrested after the attack.

zh.s: 2014年5月21日，一名台湾男子在台北捷运列车上随机持刀袭击乘客，地点靠近江子翠站，造成4人死亡、24人受伤。这是台北捷运自1996年运营以来首起致命袭击。袭击者、21岁的郑捷在案发后被捕。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kidal took place during the Mali War, when MNLA forces in control of Kidal attacked Prime Minister Moussa Mara's convoy during a visit to the town. Consequently, Malian government forces launched an offensive to retake the city, successfully recapturing it. Since the foreign intervention in Mali, Kidal was retaken by French, Malian, and Chadian troops.

zh.s: 第二次基达尔战役发生在马里战争期间。控制基达尔的阿扎瓦德民族解放运动（MNLA）武装在穆萨·马拉总理访问该镇期间袭击其车队。随后，马里政府军发动攻势夺回城市并取得成功。马里发生外国军事干预后，基达尔又被法国、马里和乍得部队夺回。

en.s: The 2015 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2014–15 Russian Cup, the 23rd season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 21 May 2015 at the Central Stadium in Astrakhan, between Lokomotiv Moscow and Kuban Krasnodar. Lokomotiv came back from behind and emerged victorious with a 3-1 win in extra time.

zh.s: 2015年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2014—15赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，这是俄罗斯主要足球杯赛的第23个赛季。比赛于2015年5月21日在阿斯特拉罕中央体育场举行，由莫斯科火车头对阵克拉斯诺达尔库班。莫斯科火车头先失一球，随后反超，在加时赛后以3比1获胜。

en.s: The 2016 Scottish Cup Final was the 131st final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 2015–16 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Hampden Park on 21 May 2016 and was contested by Scottish Championship teams Rangers and Hibernian. It was the first final to be contested by two teams from outside the top tier of the Scottish football league system.

zh.s: 2016年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事第131届决赛，也是2015—16赛季决赛。比赛于2016年5月21日在汉普顿公园举行，由苏格兰冠军联赛球队流浪者和希伯尼安对阵。这是苏格兰杯决赛首次由两支苏格兰足球联赛顶级联赛以外的球队交锋。

en.s: The 2016 FA Cup final was an association football match between Crystal Palace and Manchester United on 21 May 2016 at Wembley Stadium in London, England, organised by the Football Association (FA). It marked the 135th final of the Football Association Challenge Cup (FA Cup) and was the showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition. It was Manchester United's first FA Cup final appearance since 2007, when they lost 1–0 to Chelsea.

zh.s: 2016年英格兰足总杯决赛于2016年5月21日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由水晶宫对阵曼联，是英格兰足总杯第135届决赛，也是英格兰主要杯赛的焦点之战。曼联上一次闯入足总杯决赛是在2007年，当时以0比1负于切尔西。

en.s: The 2016 Indian Federation Cup final was a football match played on 21 May 2016 at the Indira Gandhi Stadium in Guwahati between Aizawl and Mohun Bagan. Mohun Bagan won the final by defeating Aizawl 5–0 with a brace from Jeje Lalpekhlua and goals each from Sony Norde, Dhanachandra Singh and Bikramjit Singh.

zh.s: 2016年印度联邦杯决赛于2016年5月21日在古瓦哈蒂英迪拉·甘地体育场举行，由艾藻尔对阵莫亨巴根。莫亨巴根以5比0获胜，杰杰·拉尔佩赫鲁瓦梅开二度，索尼·诺尔德、达纳钱德拉·辛格和比克拉姆吉特·辛格各进一球。

en.s: The 2016 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2015–16 DFB-Pokal, the 73rd season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 21 May 2016 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Borussia Dortmund, who had lost in the two previous finals, faced Bayern Munich, the record title-holders. Bayern won 4–3 on penalties, as the match had finished 0–0 after extra time, giving Bayern their 18th title.

zh.s: 2016年德国杯决赛决出了2015—16赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰赛第73个赛季。比赛于2016年5月21日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。连续两年在决赛中失利的多特蒙德对阵夺冠次数最多的拜仁慕尼黑。比赛在加时赛后仍以0比0战平，拜仁在点球大战中以4比3获胜，第18次夺冠。

en.s: The 2016 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that was played on 21 May 2016 in Lviv. For the first time the cup final was held in Lviv. The match was the 25th Ukrainian Cup Final and was contested by Zorya Luhansk and Shakhtar Donetsk.

zh.s: 2016年乌克兰杯决赛于2016年5月21日在利沃夫举行，这是杯赛决赛首次在利沃夫举行。比赛是乌克兰杯第25届决赛，由卢甘斯克索尔亚对阵顿涅茨克矿工。

en.s: The 2016 Coppa Italia final decided the winner of the 2015–16 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 21 May 2016 at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome, between rivals Milan and Juventus. Since Juventus won the 2015–16 Serie A, Milan secured their place in the 2016 Supercoppa Italiana. Juventus won the match 1–0 after extra time, with a 110th-minute goal by the substitute Álvaro Morata with his first touch, successfully defending their title.

zh.s: 2016年意大利杯决赛决出了2015—16赛季意大利主要足球杯赛的冠军。比赛于2016年5月21日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由老对手AC米兰和尤文图斯交锋。尤文图斯赢得2015—16赛季意甲冠军后，AC米兰取得参加2016年意大利超级杯的资格。尤文图斯在加时赛后以1比0获胜，第110分钟替补登场的阿尔瓦罗·莫拉塔第一次触球便打入制胜球，帮助球队成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2016 Coupe de France final decided the winner of the 2015–16 Coupe de France, the 99th season of France's all-main-divisions football cup. It took place on 21 May at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, Paris. In the final, Olympique de Marseille took on arch-rivals Paris Saint-Germain, in a rematch of the 2006 final, which PSG won 2–1.

zh.s: 2016年法国杯决赛决出了2015—16赛季法国杯冠军，这是法国杯涵盖各级联赛球队的第99个赛季。比赛于5月21日在巴黎圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。决赛由马赛奥林匹克对阵宿敌巴黎圣日耳曼，是2006年决赛的重演；当年巴黎圣日耳曼以2比1获胜。

en.s: On 21 May 2016, Akhtar Mansur, the second leader of the Taliban, was killed in a U.S. military drone strike on the N-40 National Highway in Pakistan near Ahmad Wal, not far from the Pakistan–Afghanistan border; Mansur had crossed earlier that day from Iran into Pakistan through the Taftan, Balochistan, border crossing, some 450 kilometres (280 mi) away from the spot where he was killed.

zh.s: 2016年5月21日，塔利班第二任领导人阿赫塔尔·曼苏尔在巴基斯坦N-40国道、靠近艾哈迈德瓦利的路段遭美国军用无人机袭击身亡。该地离巴基斯坦—阿富汗边境不远。当天早些时候，曼苏尔从伊朗穿过俾路支省塔夫坦边境口岸进入巴基斯坦；口岸距离他遇袭地点约450公里（280英里）。

en.s: The 2017 Backlash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brand, SmackDown. It was the 13th Backlash and took place on May 21, 2017, at the Allstate Arena in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. Eight matches were contested at the event, including one on the Kickoff pre-show.

zh.s: 《反击》（2017年）是WWE主办的付费电视及网络直播职业摔角赛事，只有SmackDown主力品牌的选手参加。这是第13届《反击》，于2017年5月21日在伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特的奥尔斯泰特竞技场举行。赛事共进行了8场比赛，其中1场在开场秀中举行。

en.t: 3rd Justice and Development Party Extraordinary Congress
en.s: The 3rd Justice and Development Party Extraordinary Congress took place on 20 and 21 May 2017 in order to elect a party leader and members to the party congress of Turkey's ruling Justice and Development Party (AK Party). The party's founder and first leader, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, was the only candidate for the post, having left the leadership upon his election as President in 2014.

zh.t: 正义与发展党第3届特别代表大会
zh.s: 土耳其执政党正义与发展党（AK党）于2017年5月20日至21日召开第3届特别代表大会，选举党主席和党代表大会成员。该党创始人、首任党主席雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安是唯一候选人；他于2014年当选总统后离开党主席职位。

en.s: The 2017 Indian Federation Cup final was a football match between Bengaluru FC and Mohun Bagan played on 21 May 2017 at Barabati Stadium in Cuttack. Bengaluru FC won their second Federation Cup title after having won the first time in 2014–15.

zh.s: 2017年印度联邦杯决赛于2017年5月21日在卡塔克巴拉巴蒂体育场举行，由班加罗尔FC对阵莫亨巴根。班加罗尔FC获胜，第二次夺得联邦杯冠军；球队此前在2014—15赛季首次夺冠。

en.s: The 2016–17 FA Vase final was the 43rd final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Cleethorpes Town and South Shields. This was first time both teams had reached the final and their first visit to Wembley Stadium. The final of the FA Trophy was played on the same day at the same venue for the second year running.

zh.s: 2016—17赛季英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是英格兰足总杯赛的第43届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛系统第9至第11级。对阵双方是克利索普斯镇和南希尔兹。两队都是首次闯入决赛，也都是首次到温布利球场比赛。连续第二年，足总锦标赛决赛也在同一天、同一场地举行。

en.s: The 2016–17 FA Trophy Final was the 48th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 5–8 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Macclesfield Town and York City. The final of the FA Vase was played on the same day at the same venue for the second year running. Both matches were televised in the UK on BT Sport.

zh.s: 2016—17赛季英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总杯赛的第48届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛系统第5至第8级。对阵双方是麦克尔斯菲尔德镇和约克城。连续第二年，足总花瓶杯决赛也在同一天、同一场地举行。两场决赛均由英国BT Sport电视台转播。

en.s: A special election was held on May 21, 2019, to fill the remainder of the term for Pennsylvania's 12th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives for the 116th United States Congress. Tom Marino, a Republican, resigned from office effective January 23.

zh.t: 2019年宾夕法尼亚州第12国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2019年5月21日举行特别选举，选出美国众议院第116届国会宾夕法尼亚州第12国会选区代表，填补任期剩余部分。共和党众议员汤姆·马里诺于1月23日辞职。

en.s: General elections were held in Malawi on 21 May 2019 to elect the President, National Assembly and local government councillors. Incumbent President Peter Mutharika of the Democratic Progressive Party was re-elected, with his party remaining the largest in the National Assembly. On 3 February 2020, the Constitutional Court annulled the presidential election results due to evidence of irregularities, and ordered fresh elections be held.

zh.s: 马拉维于2019年5月21日举行大选，选出总统、国民议会议员和地方政府议员。民主进步党候选人、时任总统彼得·穆塔里卡连任，该党继续成为国民议会第一大党。2020年2月3日，宪法法院因发现选举违规证据，宣布总统选举结果无效，并要求重新举行选举。

en.t: 2019 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: There were three special elections to the United States House of Representatives in 2019 during the 116th United States Congress. Two of the three seats were won by the party previously holding the seat. One seat, which was left vacant, was picked up by the Republican Party.

en.s: A federal election was held on 21 May 2022 to elect members of the 47th Parliament of Australia. The incumbent Liberal–National Coalition government, led by Prime Minister Scott Morrison, sought to win a fourth consecutive term in office but was defeated by the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Anthony Albanese.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于2022年5月21日举行联邦选举，选出第47届联邦议会议员。时任总理斯科特·莫里森领导的自由党—国家党联盟试图连续第四次执政，但败给了由反对党领袖安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯领导的工党。

en.s: The 2022 EFL League One play-off final was an association football match between Wycombe Wanderers and Sunderland on 21 May 2022 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League One, the third tier of English football, to the EFL Championship.

zh.t: 2022年英格兰足球甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2022年英格兰足球甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2022年5月21日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由韦康比流浪者对阵桑德兰。比赛决出从英甲（英格兰第三级别联赛）升入英冠的第三支、也是最后一支球队。

en.s: The 2022 Scottish Cup Final was the 137th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 2021–22 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match was played on 21 May 2022 at Hampden Park, Glasgow. St Johnstone, the defending champions were defeated in Round Four. Rangers beat Heart of Midlothian 2–0 in extra time.

zh.s: 2022年苏格兰杯决赛是第137届苏格兰杯决赛，也是2021—22赛季的决赛，于2022年5月21日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园举行。卫冕冠军圣约翰斯通在第四轮出局。流浪者在加时赛中以2比0击败哈茨。

en.s: The 2022 DFB-Pokal final was an association football match played between RB Leipzig and SC Freiburg at the Olympiastadion in Berlin on 21 May 2022. Organized by the German Football Association (DFB), it was the 79th final of the competition and the first match which allowed full capacity in two years, due to the COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

zh.s: 2022年德国杯决赛于2022年5月21日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，由莱比锡RB对阵弗赖堡。这是德国足协主办的德国顶级淘汰赛第79届决赛，也是两年来首次开放满场观众入场；此前因德国的新冠疫情而限制观众人数。

en.s: On May 21, 2022, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin attacked the city of Bourzanga, Burkina Faso, but the attack was repelled by Burkinabe and French forces.

zh.s: 2022年5月21日，伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织的圣战分子袭击布基纳法索布尔赞加市，但被布基纳法索和法国军队击退。

en.s: The 2022 Australian Senate election was held on 21 May 2022 to elect 40 of the 76 senators in the Australian Senate as part of the 2022 federal election. Senators elected at this election took office on 1 July 2022, with the exception of the senators elected from two territories whose terms commenced from election day.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于2022年5月21日联邦选举期间举行参议院选举，改选76名参议员中的40名。此次选出的参议员于2022年7月1日就任；两个领地选出的参议员例外，他们从选举日当天开始任期。

en.s: The 2022 UEFA Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2021–22 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 21st season of Europe's premier women's club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 13th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup to the UEFA Women's Champions League. The match was played at the Juventus Stadium in Turin, Italy on 21 May 2022, between Spanish club Barcelona and French club Lyon, a repeat of the 2019 final.

zh.s: 2022年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2021—22赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事的第21个赛季，以及赛事从“女子杯”更名为“女子冠军联赛”后的第13个赛季。比赛于2022年5月21日在意大利都灵尤文图斯球场举行，由西班牙巴塞罗那对阵法国里昂，重演2019年决赛。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Holm vs. Vieira
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Holm vs. Vieira (also known as UFC Fight Night 206, UFC on ESPN+ 64 or UFC Vegas 55) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 21, 2022, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：霍尔姆对阵维埃拉
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：霍尔姆对阵维埃拉也称UFC格斗之夜206、UFC ESPN+ 64或UFC拉斯维加斯55，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2022年5月21日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC巅峰训练中心举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2022 Greek Cup final was the 78th final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 21 May 2022 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Panathinaikos and PAOK. It was Panathinaikos' thirtieth Greek Cup final in their 114 years of existence and PAOK's twenty second Greek Cup final and second consecutive, of their 96-year history.

zh.s: 2022年希腊杯决赛是第78届希腊杯决赛，于2022年5月21日在奥林匹克体育场举行。对阵双方是帕纳辛奈科斯和塞萨洛尼基PAOK。这是帕纳辛奈科斯114年队史上第30次闯入决赛；PAOK在96年队史上第22次进入决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛。

en.t: Results of the 2022 Australian federal election in Western Australia
en.s: The 2022 Australian federal election was held on 21 May 2022 to elect all 151 members of the Australian House of Representatives and 40 of 76 members of the Australian Senate. Of those, 15 MPs and 6 senators were elected to represent the state of Western Australia. This election was held using Instant-runoff voting. In Western Australia in this election, there were two "turn-overs".

zh.s: 2022年5月21日举行澳大利亚联邦选举，改选众议院全部151个席位和参议院76席中的40席。其中，西澳大利亚州选出15名众议员和6名参议员。本次选举采用即时决选制。西澳大利亚州有两个选区发生政党席位易手。

en.s: This is a list of division results for the 2022 Australian federal election in the Australian Capital Territory and the Northern Territory. This election was held using Instant-runoff voting. In each district, the candidate leading in the first count took the seat, either in the first count or in the end.

en.s: Snap parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 21 May 2023 to elect all 300 members of the Hellenic Parliament. They were the first elections since 1990 to be held without a seat bonus, due to amendments to the electoral law made in 2016. The elections instead used a system of proportional representation. The New Democracy of Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis achieved victory, winning a plurality.

zh.s: 希腊于2023年5月21日举行提前议会选举，改选希腊议会全部300个席位。这是1990年以来首次在没有席位奖励的制度下举行选举，原因是2016年修改了选举法；本次选举改用比例代表制。总理基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯领导的新民主党获胜，获得相对多数。

en.s: The 2023 FA Trophy final was an association football match played at Wembley Stadium, London, on 21 May 2023. It was contested between FC Halifax Town and Gateshead. It was Halifax's second final following their victory in 2016 which was their only previous visit to the national stadium, and Gateshead's first FA Trophy final and first visit to Wembley since 2014.

zh.s: 2023年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛于2023年5月21日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由哈利法克斯镇对阵盖茨黑德。哈利法克斯此前曾于2016年闯入决赛，那是该队此前唯一一次到国家体育场比赛；盖茨黑德则首次进入足总锦标赛决赛，也是自2014年以来首次到温布利参赛。

en.s: Resurgence (2023) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). It took place on May 21, 2023, at the Walter Pyramid in Long Beach, California. It was the second event under the Resurgence name. Ten matches were contested at the event, including two on the pre-show. In the main event, Willow Nightingale defeated Mercedes Moné to win the inaugural Strong Women's Championship.

zh.t: 新日本职业摔角《复兴》（2023年）
zh.s: 《复兴》（2023年）是新日本职业摔角（NJPW）主办的付费电视职业摔角赛事，于2023年5月21日在加利福尼亚州长滩的沃尔特金字塔体育馆举行。这是第二届以“复兴”为名的赛事，共进行了10场比赛，其中2场在开场秀中举行。主赛中，威洛·南丁格尔击败梅赛德斯·莫内，成为首位强力女子冠军。

en.s: The 2023 FA Vase final was the 49th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Ascot United of the Combined Counties League Premier Division North and Newport Pagnell Town of the United Counties League Premier Division South. Newport Pagnell Town entered the game as the defending champions, reaching the final for the second successive season.

zh.s: 2023年英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是英格兰足总杯赛的第49届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛系统第9至第11级。对阵双方是联合郡联赛北部超级组的阿斯科特联和联合郡联赛南部超级组的纽波特帕格内尔镇。卫冕冠军纽波特帕格内尔镇连续第二年闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon Democratic presidential primary was held on May 21, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside Kentucky's primary and two days before Idaho's caucuses. 66 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated, with 12 additional unpledged delegates. Incumbent President Joe Biden won the primary with almost 90% ahead of the only other candidate Marianne Williamson.

zh.t: 2024年俄勒冈州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年5月21日举行俄勒冈州民主党总统初选，是民主党2024年总统候选人初选的一部分，与肯塔基州初选同日举行，比爱达荷州党团会议早两天。俄勒冈州初选分配66名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有12名不受约束的代表。时任总统乔·拜登以近90%的得票率获胜，领先唯一的另一名候选人玛丽安·威廉姆森。

en.s: The 2024 Kentucky Democratic presidential primary was held on May 21, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election, alongside Oregon's and two days before Idaho's primary. 53 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in the closed primary, with 6 additional unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2024年肯塔基州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年5月21日举行肯塔基州民主党总统初选，是民主党2024年总统候选人初选的一部分，与俄勒冈州初选同日举行，比爱达荷州初选早两天。此次封闭式初选分配53名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有6名不受约束的代表。

en.s: On 21 May 2024, a Taiwanese man carried out a stabbing spree directed at passengers on a Taichung MRT train, near Taichung City Hall station. Three people, including the attacker, were injured. The attack occurred exactly ten years after the 2014 Taipei Metro attack.

zh.s: 2024年5月21日，一名台湾男子在台中捷运列车上持刀袭击乘客，地点靠近台中市政府站。包括袭击者在内有3人受伤。袭击发生在2014年台北捷运袭击案整整10年后。

en.s: On the afternoon of May 21, 2024, a violent and destructive tornado tracked across southwestern Iowa, United States, devastating the city of Greenfield. The tornado, known most commonly as the Greenfield tornado, destroyed many buildings and wind turbines across its path that stretched through Page, Taylor, Adams, and Adair counties, while also causing more than $31 million in property damage, killing five people and injuring 35 more.

zh.s: 2024年5月21日下午，一场强烈且破坏性极大的龙卷风横扫美国艾奥瓦州西南部，重创格林菲尔德市。龙卷风沿途摧毁许多建筑和风力发电机，路径穿过佩奇、泰勒、亚当斯和阿代尔四个县，造成超过3,100万美元财产损失、5人死亡、35人受伤。

en.s: The 2024 Georgia judicial elections were held on May 21, 2024 on four Supreme Court of Georgia seats that were up for election for a six-year term. Of these four, only the seat held by Andrew Pinson was contested by former Democratic U.S. House member John Barrow. Justices Michael Boggs, John Ellington and Nels Peterson were unopposed for re-election.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2024年5月21日举行司法选举，改选佐治亚州最高法院6年任期的4个席位。其中只有安德鲁·平森担任的席位有竞争者，对手是美国众议院前民主党议员约翰·巴罗。迈克尔·博格斯、约翰·埃灵顿和内尔斯·彼得森3名法官均无人竞争，成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Multnomah County District Attorney election was held on May 21, 2024, to elect the district attorney of Multnomah County, Oregon, which includes the state's largest city, Portland. Senior deputy district attorney Nathan Vasquez defeated incumbent Mike Schmidt. Since Vasquez won a majority of the vote in this primary election, there was no general election for this office in November 2024.

zh.t: 2024年马特诺玛县地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2024年5月21日，俄勒冈州举行马特诺玛县地方检察官选举。马特诺玛县包括该州最大城市波特兰。资深副地方检察官内森·瓦斯奎兹击败时任地方检察官迈克·施密特。瓦斯奎兹在初选中得票过半，因此2024年11月没有举行大选。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Pictou West in Nova Scotia on May 21, 2024, to elect a new member of the Nova Scotia House of Assembly following the resignation of Progressive Conservative MLA Karla MacFarlane. The deadline for candidate nominations is May 1, 2024. Progressive Conservative Premier Tim Houston called the by-election quickly, only two weeks after MacFarlane's resignation, suggesting the party is confident they will hold the seat.

zh.t: 2024年新斯科舍省皮克图西区补选
zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省皮克图西区于2024年5月21日举行省议会补选，选出新斯科舍省议会的新议员。时任进步保守党议员卡拉·麦克法兰辞职后，选区出现空缺。候选人提名截止日期为2024年5月1日。进步保守党省长蒂姆·休斯顿在麦克法兰辞职仅两周后便迅速宣布补选，显示该党对保住席位信心十足。

en.s: The 2024 California's 20th congressional district special election was held on March 19, 2024, with a runoff on May 21 because no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round. It elected a new member of the United States House of Representatives to replace Kevin McCarthy, who resigned on December 31, 2023, following his removal as speaker of the House.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州第20国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州第20国会选区特别选举首轮投票于2024年3月19日举行。由于无人得票超过50%，5月21日举行决选，选出美国众议院议员，接替于2023年12月31日辞职的凯文·麦卡锡。麦卡锡此前被罢免众议院议长职务。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Barbadian constituency of Saint James North on 21 May 2025, following the resignation of incumbent Barbados Labour Party (BLP) Member of Parliament Edmund Hinkson, who had represented the constituency since the 2013 Barbadian general election. It was the first by-election held after Barbados became a republic.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯圣詹姆斯北选区于2025年5月21日举行补选。时任议员、巴巴多斯工党成员埃德蒙·欣克森辞职后，该选区出现空缺；他自2013年巴巴多斯大选以来一直代表该选区。这是巴巴多斯成为共和国后的首场补选。

en.s: The 2025 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2024–25 UEFA Europa League, the 54th season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organized by UEFA, and the 16th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. The match was played at San Mamés in Bilbao, Spain, on 21 May 2025, between English clubs Tottenham Hotspur and Manchester United.

zh.s: 2025年欧洲联赛决赛是2024—25赛季欧洲联赛的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部次级赛事的第54个赛季、第16个以“欧洲联赛”为名的赛季。比赛于2025年5月21日在西班牙毕尔巴鄂圣马梅斯球场举行，由英格兰托特纳姆热刺对阵曼联。

en.s: The 2025 Abujhmarh clash was an encounter between Communist Party of India (Maoist) and Indian security forces in the Abujhmarh forest area in Chhattisgarh, India. It was among the deadliest clashes in the recent history of the Naxalite–Maoist insurgency in India. The Maoist leader Nambala Keshava Rao, having a combined bounty of ₹3.5 Crore (around US$410,000), was killed in the encounter.

zh.s: 2025年，印度恰蒂斯加尔邦阿布杰马尔森林地区的印度共产党（毛主义）武装与印度安全部队发生冲突。这是印度纳萨尔派—毛主义叛乱近年来伤亡最惨重的冲突之一。毛派领导人纳姆巴拉·凯沙瓦·拉奥在交战中被击毙，当时他身上悬赏金合计3.5亿卢比（约41万美元）。
